selection_policy: Explicit registry of GM24 2026, 2025 lineage, and maieutic texts. SHA-256 exact deduplication (never name-only), prefer current version then newest mtime for byte-identical copies. Filename = normalized original stem + first 12 hex of SHA-256; a changed file gets a new name. Previous source versions are kept in archived_versions, not deleted. No source is moved, renamed, decrypted or overwritten.
